return { json: { statement: "
MERGE (r:graph {id: $recipe.id})
SET r += {title: $recipe.title, description: $recipe.description, minutes: $recipe.minutes,
          source: $recipe.source, instructions: $recipe.instructions,
          cuisine: $recipe.cuisine, ingredients: $recipe.ingredients, dietaryTags: $recipe.dietaryTags}
WITH r
OPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[old:USES|IN_CUISINE|HAS_TAG]->()
WITH r, collect(old) AS previous
FOREACH (rel IN previous | DELETE rel)
WITH r
MERGE (c:Cuisine {name: $recipe.cuisine})
MERGE (r)-[:IN_CUISINE]->(c)
FOREACH (name IN $recipe.ingredients |
  MERGE (i:Ingredient {name: name})
  MERGE (r)-[:USES]->(i))
FOREACH (name IN $recipe.dietaryTags |
  MERGE (d:DietaryTag {name: name})
  MERGE (r)-[:HAS_TAG]->(d))
RETURN r.id AS id, r.title AS title
", parameters: { recipe: $("Recipe data").item.json } } };
